description.short: Start and continue T3 Code work from Microsoft Teams.
description.full: Runs T3 Code engineering sessions from Teams conversations or from the Start T3 investigation message action.

commands.title: stop
commands.description: Stop the active T3 turn in this conversation.

commands.title: approve
commands.description: Approve a pending T3 request by request id.

commands.title: deny
commands.description: Deny a pending T3 request by request id.

commands.title: answer
commands.description: Answer a T3 user-input request with a JSON object.

commands.title: Start T3 investigation
commands.description: Start a T3 investigation from the selected message.
